WinFrame Windows Automation Studio 1.0

Version 1.0.0 • Windows 11 x64 (.NET 10) ClickOnce Auto-Updater Win32 + UIA + OpenCvSharp4 Step Inverse & Range Queue

Local & Remote Keyword-Driven + Object-Oriented Windows Test Framework uniting Win32 Native P/Invoke, Microsoft UI Automation (UIA), OpenCvSharp4 Vision & Snipping, Win32 GDI Control Outlining, Developer Step & Inverse Range Execution, and Process Re-Harnessing.

⚙ Download Windows 11 Installer (WinFrame.Installer.exe) • Self-Contained ⬇ ClickOnce Auto-Updater (setup.exe) 📦 WinFrame.Core.dll Library GitHub Repository

Install, Auto-Update & Deliverables

1. Windows 11 Installer & ClickOnce Auto-Updater

Run WinFrame.Installer.exe for the standalone Windows 11 GUI Setup Wizard (all binaries and OpenCV runtimes embedded — no extra prerequisites required, includes Desktop & Start Menu shortcuts, Startup registration, and clean uninstaller). Alternatively, install via setup.exe for ClickOnce auto-updating on every push to main. You can also check for updates anytime inside About → Check for Updates Now or via winframe update.

2. WinFrame.Core.dll (Embeddable Class Library)

Attach directly to any Windows Forms, WPF, or console project. Provides Win32Automation, UiaAutomation, OpenCvAutomation, Win32Highlighter, ProcessManagementEngine, ControlRepository, StepQueueController, AutoUpdateManager, and OOP base classes (TestBase, ScreenObject, UIControl).

3. WinFrame.App.exe, WinFrame.Cli.exe & WinFrame.Service.exe

Full Desktop Studio with Hand of Glory splash screen, tray icon + scrolling marquee status, Load Tests Queue, Developer Step Forward / Inverse / Range (1-3, 4-1) bar, Create Tests recorder with the right-hand Accessory Control Naming Panel, plus CLI runner and remote HTTP REST service.

Local IDE Debugging (F5) & Terminal Commands

# Build & Run all xUnit Tests
dotnet build WinFrame.sln
dotnet test WinFrame.sln

# Launch WinFrame Desktop Studio (WinForms GUI)
dotnet run --project src/WinFrame.App/WinFrame.App.csproj

# Run a Keyword Sheet or Reverse Step Range from CLI
dotnet run --project src/WinFrame.Cli/WinFrame.Cli.csproj -- run samples/highlight_and_inverse_demo.csv
dotnet run --project src/WinFrame.Cli/WinFrame.Cli.csproj -- range samples/highlight_and_inverse_demo.csv 6-4
dotnet run --project src/WinFrame.Cli/WinFrame.Cli.csproj -- update --check

# Launch the Windows 11 Setup Wizard GUI or Build Installer Package
dotnet run --project src/WinFrame.Installer/WinFrame.Installer.csproj
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\installer\build_installer.ps1

Developer Step Queue, Rule-Based Inversion & Range Execution

Run steps one by one, step backward with automatic rule-based inversion (entering text becomes deleting text; checking becomes unchecking; expanding becomes collapsing), or execute any forward or reverse range:

// C# OOP & StepQueueController example
var engine = new KeywordFramework();
var controller = engine.CreateStepController(myTest, autoInverseOnError: true);

controller.StepNext();                   // Step 1 forward
controller.StepPrevious(useInverse:true);// Reverses step 1 using StepInversionEngine
controller.ExecuteRange("1-3");          // Runs steps 1, 2, 3 forward
controller.ExecuteRange("4-2");          // Walks 4 -> 3 -> 2 in reverse and executes each step's inverse!

Win32 GDI Control Highlighting

Set highlight = "1" or "true" in config/test variables to outline every targeted control with a Win32 GDI pen for the configured short interval (set to "0", "", or null to turn off), or use the special HIGHLIGHT keyword command in any sheet:

Action Target Value Description
HIGHLIGHT @button_1,@edit_1 #F59E0B|280|3 Outlines controls with Win32 GDI when highlight=1/true
UIA_INVOKE @button_1 Invokes UIA InvokePattern (with native click fallback)
UIA_SET_VALUE @edit_1 Hello World Sets value (inverse automatically clears/restores text)
CV_SNAPSHOT_CONTROL @button_1 Captures OpenCV control + window snapshot to Control Sheet
CV_CLICK_IMAGE @button_1 0.85 Finds control on screen via OpenCvSharp template matching and clicks
